scope: Final client HTTP timeout measurement repair only; no human fidelity, performance or provider-receipt approval.

targetedSuite.scope: New117 plus related native transport, core, human adapter and visual comparison tests; not the full repository suite.

findingWitnesses.meaning: Assertions confirm current defective behavior. These passes do not mean acceptance.

realClosureAndNative.qualification: Adapter closure is the current source slice transpiled in VM with deterministic reservation and clocks, joined to actual native function and a local fetch stub. The response-body test spy records21950 but returns a5ms signal to avoid a22second wall-clock wait; existing native tests separately cover real5ms body timeout.

findings.repro: Use the exact experience-visual-conditions profile in the local browser fixture. Remove measurement.visualHTTP and every timing.httpDispatch; recompute input hashes. Execute the actual comparison replay-guard line in an isolated VM with this directory.
findings.expected: Nonmock visual-enabled comparison explicitly requires finalVisualHTTP and rejects the downgraded record.
findings.actual: The guard passes no requirements and sets record.replay.status=OK. Explicit required replay rejects FINAL_VISUAL_HTTP_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED.
findings.fix: Pass finalVisualHTTP for nonmock actors whose frozen profile enables visualHypotheses; preserve default replay compatibility for legacy logs and nonvisual actors.
findings.qualification: Actual guard line executed, not an external nonmock batch. Preceding identity checks do not inspect the measurement marker or trace. Other comparison runners without visual-enabled actors were not classified as this defect.

findings.repro: Call runBeta with nativeHTTPMeasurement:true and a real native extractor whose wrapper omits forwarding the optional audit observer.
findings.expected: The explicitly declared measurement contract fails closed on a successful admitted visual response without the native trace, stops before actor evaluation and produces an invalid record.
findings.actual: Two actual native stubbed HTTP calls and four actor evaluations complete. traceCount=0, measurement.visualHTTP=final-timeout-v1, validForComparison=true, objectiveSuccess=true. Required replay subsequently rejects VISUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_MISSING.
findings.fix: When the native measurement flag is set, validate required trace presence before accepting a visual response or continuing to actor evaluation, and classify missing measurement as invalid. Preserve flags-absent legacy extractor compatibility and attempts0 nondispatch cases.
findings.qualification: Direct core API contract reproduction. Current normal runHumanJev adapter itself forwards the observer; this is not evidence that normal native transport silently loses its trace.

limitations: No external API request, external env file, human data, commit or push was used.
No product, normal tests or existing documentation was edited by this verifier.
No server receipt or provider processing/start evidence is inferred from the native timeout scalar.

First independent harness attempt failed on cross-VM object prototypes and repeated deterministic clocks; its log is retained as independent-tests-harness-attempt1.log. Only the private harness was corrected before the passing rerun.
The whole exploration/human-validation goal is not assessed or completed.
